October 14, 2026


The[Saskatchewan Roughriders](https://facebook.com/11693281540) are hosting their annual Pink Game on Oct. 17 in support of the Cameco Riders Touchdown for Dreams program. This year's Pink Game merchandise, featuring a cozy pink toque and matching mitts, is available now at the Rider Store and will also be sold by Team Cameco volunteers at Mosaic Stadium on game day. Every purchase helps support the program, which is celebrating 15 years of creating memorable moments and experiences for women living with a life-threatening cancer diagnosis. So pick up your pink gear and help make dreams come true for Saskatchewan families. 💗🏈[#TD4D](https://facebook.com/hashtag/TD4D)[#ThinkPink](https://facebook.com/hashtag/ThinkPink)[#RiderNation](https://facebook.com/hashtag/RiderNation)[Cancer Foundation of Saskatchewan](https://facebook.com/553284501770606)
